changeSet.author: josh
changeSet.comment: Add index on orders.order_status to optimize order filtering by status in dashboard and order APIs
changeSet.sql: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_orders_order_status ON public.orders(order_status);

changeSet.author: josh
changeSet.comment: Add index on orders.order_type to optimize filtering by dine-in / takeaway order type
changeSet.sql: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_orders_order_type ON public.orders(order_type);

changeSet.author: josh
changeSet.comment: Add functional index on LOWER(orders.order_number) to optimize case-insensitive order number searches
changeSet.sql: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_orders_order_number_lower ON orders(LOWER(order_number));

changeSet.author: josh
changeSet.comment: Add index on sessions.expired_at to improve queries checking expired_at IS NULL OR expired_at > now()
changeSet.sql: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_sessions_expired_at ON public.sessions(expired_at);

changeSet.author: josh
changeSet.comment: Add index on transaction.transaction_status to optimize filtering transactions by status
changeSet.sql: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_transaction_transaction_status ON public.transaction(transaction_status);

changeSet.author: josh
changeSet.comment: Add index on transaction.payment_method to optimize filtering transactions by payment method
changeSet.sql: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_transaction_payment_method ON public.transaction(payment_method);
